idea.title: AI LinkedIn post writer in your voice, $19/month

source.text: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice, $19 a month. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug linkedin-ai-writer.

idea.problem: Writing LinkedIn posts that sound like you takes time; generic AI output sounds like AI.
idea.solution: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in the user's own voice.
claims: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice
assumptions: Customer assumed: US consultants, solo founders and B2B professionals who post on LinkedIn weekly.
Channel assumed: none in hand (no audience stated); paid search or LinkedIn Ads plus organic launches.
Voice is learned from posts the user pastes or exports, not by scraping LinkedIn.
Stripe US card fee assumed at 2.9% + $0.30 (the page served was the EUR version).
Headless run: no questions asked; follow-up facts (audience size, validation) assumed to be zero.

confidence.note: Raised by the real CPC for 'linkedin post generator' (Keyword Planner) and churn data for web AI writing tools.

gross_margin.note: About 94% margin (LLM ~$0.16, Stripe ~$0.98 per user); lowered from 5 by the R4 cap.

pricing_power.note: Free extensions and ChatGPT set the floor; Supergrow dropped its $19 tier; $15 entry plans exist.

build_effort.note: An LLM wrapper with voice samples: about 2-3 weeks at 10 h/week for a developer (estimate).

skills_match.note: Developer covers the build; prompt quality, copywriting and marketing are learnable gaps.

capital_needed.note: Fixed costs about $27/month; $1,000 budget covers a year of tooling.

time_to_mvp.note: Working MVP in about 3 weeks at 10 h/week (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: Self-serve card purchase after a short trial; no committee.

channel_readiness.note: No audience; paid search ~$12.48/click non-branded; R5 cap (no_distribution).

search_demand.note: Heavy usage: 78% of long LinkedIn posts flagged likely AI; r/linkedin ~170k members.

trend.note: AI-post usage up from 54% (2024) to 78% (2026), but LinkedIn now cuts AI-slop reach 40%.

willingness_to_pay.note: Competitors charge $39-$99, but free tiers abound and AI apps churn 30% faster.

free_alternatives.note: ChatGPT with pasted samples, free style-saving extensions, ContentIn free tool: R1 cap.

competitor_density.note: 8+ paid tools (Taplio, Supergrow, EasyGen, Kleo, ContentIn) plus 5+ PH launches in 2026.

differentiation.note: 'In your voice' is every rival's pitch (beamio, VoiceMoat, Postking); being a developer is no edge.

legal_regulatory.note: CCPA thresholds out of reach; FTC fake-review rule does not cover own ghostwritten posts.

platform_dependency.note: LinkedIn bans scraping extensions, gates posting API and down-ranks AI slop.

market_risk.note: AI-slop backlash: 1M+ slop-button clicks in 2 weeks could shrink the habit.

skills.note: Builds the product; no stated marketing, sales or writing track record.

assets.note: No audience, list or network stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no stated passion for LinkedIn content.

rules_applied.effect: Free tools (ChatGPT with samples, style-saving extensions) do the job; no specific edge: Competitive room capped at 1.5.
LTV:CAC 0.23 with no path at $19: Profit potential capped at 2 (gross_margin lowered 5 to 4).
no_distribution: channel_readiness 1.5; free_alternative: free_alternatives 1; legal_platform_risk: platform_dependency 2.
No channel and LTV:CAC below 1: total capped at 49.

tam.reasoning: Global AI writing assistant software, 2024; 360iResearch says $1.13B, so treat as a range.

sam.reasoning: No source splits out LinkedIn post writing in the US.

som.reasoning: 50 paying customers x $19 x 12 months = $11,400 (year 1, solo founder).

competitors_found.reasoning: Taplio, Supergrow, EasyGen, Kleo, ContentIn, Typegrow, AuthoredUp, Waalaxy (adjacent), Postiz; plus 5 dated PH launches.

demand_trend.reasoning: Likely-AI long posts 54% (Oct 2024) to 78% (Sep 2026); LinkedIn cuts AI-slop views 40%.

price.reasoning: The founder's stated price; matches AuthoredUp ($19.95) and the old Supergrow Starter.

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: LLM: 270k input x $0.25/M + 45k output x $2/M = $0.16; Stripe 2.9% + $0.30 = $0.85; Billing 0.7% = $0.13. Total $1.14.

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: B2C SaaS 5.8%/month (Focus Digital) x 1.3 AI premium (RevenueCat) = 7.5%, rounded to 8% within a 6-10% range.

cac.reasoning: Non-branded Google CPC $12.48 / 1.3% = ~$950; LinkedIn Ads $11.12 / 1.3% = ~$850; range $267-$2,200.

payback_months.reasoning: $950 / $17.86 per month = 53 months, longer than the 12.5-month lifetime.

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Supabase Pro $25 + domain ~$2; hosting on a free tier (Vercel limits unknown).

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $27 / $17.86 = 1.5, rounded up to 2. Side-income goal of $1,000/month needs ~56 customers.

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 3 weeks to MVP at 10 h/week + 2 weeks of launch posts and trials.

verdict.launch_reason: The founder's chosen market, and the largest LinkedIn market.
verdict.cheapest_test: Pre-sell a $300/month done-for-you post package to 50 US consultants by LinkedIn DM in 7 days; 2 paid pilots or stop.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 paid pilots ($300) from 50 DMs by day 7: stop the service path.
Fewer than 10 replies to 50 DMs by day 5: change the segment before writing anything.
If the SaaS is built anyway: fewer than 5 paying users at $19 after 60 days: archive it.

rescue.change: Sell done-for-you voice-matched LinkedIn posts to US consultants at $300/month, using the tool internally, via 50 LinkedIn DMs a week.
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac and pricing_power: buyers already pay ghostwriters $500-$1,500/month, so one client covers a paid CAC.
rescue.requires: Editing and writing skill the founder has not shown; caps at about 4 clients at 10 h/week.

rescue.change: Sell a multi-client voice workspace to LinkedIn ghostwriters and small agencies at $79/month per writer.
rescue.why: Fixes pricing_power and differentiation: ghostwriters manage several voices, a job ChatGPT does poorly.
rescue.requires: Direct sales to a small, hard-to-reach niche; 20+ interviews first.

rescue.change: Niche for developers: turn GitHub commits, changelogs and blog posts into LinkedIn posts for dev advocates and engineering leads.
rescue.why: Uses the founder's developer edge for differentiation and a free channel (Show HN, dev communities).
rescue.requires: Proof that dev advocates will pay; $19 price still leaves LTV:CAC thin.

type_checks.note: B2C SaaS 5.8%/month; AI apps churn 30% higher, only 6.1% of monthly AI subs active after a year. Estimate 6-10%/month.
Lock-in is a stored voice profile and a schedule queue: a user can paste 10 old posts into ChatGPT and leave.

narrative.answer: NO-GO at 46/100. **Customer acquisition** costs about $950 while a $19 customer is worth about $223, and **free tools** already write in your voice. LinkedIn is now cutting the reach of AI posts.
tldr: The job is already free: ChatGPT with pasted samples and free extensions that save your style.
With no audience, paid CAC (~$950) is 4x the lifetime value (~$223): every customer loses money.
LinkedIn cut AI-slop views by 40% in 2026 and keeps adding detection: the platform is moving against the product.

key_findings.title: Every customer loses money
key_findings.detail: Non-branded clicks cost **$12.48**; at 1.3% visitor-to-paid, CAC is ~$950 against an LTV of ~**$223**.

key_findings.title: Free tools do the core job
key_findings.detail: A free Chrome extension **saves your writing style** with 10 free posts a day; ContentIn's generator needs no login.

key_findings.title: LinkedIn is turning against AI posts
key_findings.detail: LinkedIn shows AI slop **40% fewer views** and its slop button got 1M+ clicks in 2 weeks.

narrative.recommendation: Do not build the $19 SaaS. If you want this market, run the 7-day pre-sale of a $300/month done-for-you service and build only if 2 consultants pay.
narrative.steelman: A developer can ship this in 3 weeks for under $100 at **94% gross margin**, and 78% of long LinkedIn posts are already AI-assisted. Evidence: the demand is real, but free tools serve it and paid acquisition costs 4x what a customer brings.
narrative.lesson: A cheap wrapper on a free model needs a free channel; without an audience, $19/month cannot pay for customers.

premortem.cause: No channel: launch posts and a $1,000 ad test bring a handful of trials and almost no paid users.
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 3 paid users after spending $500 on ads (40 clicks).

premortem.cause: Trial users go back to ChatGPT with their pasted samples once the novelty fades.
premortem.early_signal: More than 15% of the first cohort cancel in month 1.

premortem.cause: LinkedIn's AI-slop classifiers cut reach for users' posts, so they blame and drop the tool.
premortem.early_signal: Users report impressions down 30%+ versus their own baseline.

changes.what: LinkedIn says posts flagged as AI slop are no longer recommended outside the poster's network.
LinkedIn drops its AI rewrite button, adds AI-slop classifiers and a voice-keeping proofreader.
LinkedIn reports 40% fewer views on AI-slop content; the slop button got 1M+ clicks in 2 weeks.
LLM costs fell to $0.25/M input tokens (GPT-5 mini), making the wrapper trivially cheap for anyone.
5+ 'learns your voice' LinkedIn writers launched on Product Hunt in 2026 alone.

why_now.note: Cheap models opened the window years ago; in 2026 the platform and a crowd of clones are closing it.

icp.who: US consultants, solo founders and B2B sellers who post on LinkedIn weekly to win clients.
icp.pays_for_today: Freelance ghostwriters at $500-$1,500/month, Taplio AI at $69/month, or ChatGPT Plus at $20/month.
icp.trigger: unknown (not sourced; likely starting a consultancy, a fundraise or a job search).

customer.segment: US consultants and solo B2B founders who post weekly on LinkedIn
customer.pain: Writing posts that sound like them takes hours; generic AI output is recognised and penalised.
customer.today: ChatGPT with pasted samples, Taplio or Supergrow, or a freelance ghostwriter.

use_cases.name: Done-for-you posts using the tool internally
use_cases.effort: Manual, 1-2 h per client a week

free_alternative.evidence: LinkedIn Copilot extension saves your writing style with 10 free generations a day; ContentIn has a free no-login generator; ChatGPT with pasted samples does the same.

strong_competitor.evidence: Taplio (from $39/month) claims $8M ARR with Tweet Hunter before its sale to lempire (founder claim, tertiary; Latka estimated $420K in 2023).

graveyard.evidence: PostDew, a LinkedIn post generator, had 0 paying customers after 3 weeks; Jasper cut its ARR forecast 30%+ and laid off staff after ChatGPT.

no_distribution.evidence: No audience; non-branded Google clicks cost $12.48 and LinkedIn clicks $11.12, so CAC is ~$950 vs ~$223 LTV (estimate).

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Clear: GPT-5 mini at $0.25/M input and $2/M output costs ~$0.16 per user a month; margin ~94%.

weak_demand.evidence: Clear: likely-AI long LinkedIn posts rose from 54% (Oct 2024) to 78% (Sep 2026); usage is rising.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: LinkedIn bans scraping and automation extensions, gates its posting API, and shows AI-slop posts 40% fewer views.

saturated_wave.evidence: Clear, barely: 5 dated look-alike Product Hunt launches in 2026 (Postking, Post AI, beamio, Sayso, VoiceMoat), below the 10 threshold.

competitors.name: AuthoredUp
competitors.gap: Formatting and analytics, no AI writer

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: $1,000 ads over 12 months buy ~1 customer; 2-3 from launches.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.note: Organic launches only after the budget is spent; 8% churn caps growth.

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: Needs a free channel (a viral PH or HN launch); replaces 4-5 churned users a month.

risks.risk: No affordable channel to the first 10 customers.
Users churn to ChatGPT or free extensions.

risks.mitigation: Position as editing and voice-keeping, not generation.

risks.risk: Learning voice by scraping LinkedIn breaks its terms.
risks.mitigation: Use pasted posts or the user's own data export.

risks.risk: Posting API access refused or capped.

test_plan.step: List 100 US consultants who post on LinkedIn 1-2 times a week with low engagement.
Write 2 sample posts for each of 10 of them in their voice with ChatGPT plus manual edits.
DM 50 of them: free sample post, offer 8 posts a month for $300.
Send a payment link to everyone who replies positively.
